source.snippet: User is trying to import leads from a file, using the Salesforce Import Leads wizard. The tool shows a message '0 fields found and 0 fields matched' to the user, while to an Admin it shows a list of field mappings. The user has all the documented permissions assigned to them: Import Leads user permission, Lead: Read, Create, Edit, Edit access on the Lead fields being imported, Marketing User checkbox on the user record.

problem_statement: Non-admin Salesforce users with correct permissions still hit silent failures when importing leads, wasting hours debugging permission mismatches that admins cannot easily reproduce or diagnose.
target_segment: Salesforce admins and RevOps professionals at SMB-to-mid-market companies managing non-admin sales or marketing users.
notes: Recurring pain category — Salesforce permission debugging is a well-known time sink. Admins and RevOps consultants (billable hourly) would pay for a tool that audits effective user permissions and simulates what a non-admin would see. Willingness to pay inferred from consulting context; not explicit in this post. Single source, strength 2.
